trans_title: 废弃建筑之谜 第七季
introduction: Our long-running series is now into its seventh season as we continue to travel the world to seek out and explore the mysteries behind some of world’s most extraordinary abandoned places. Bridges, prisons, military installations, even entire villages and towns… these and many more have compelling stories to be told and secrets to be uncovered.1. Into the Murder Labyrinth2. Mystery of the Alien Base11. Ghosts of the Cursed Castle
